questions.question: What is the tu form of 'comprar' (to buy) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Comprar is an -ar verb: drop -ar and add -as for tú (compras), -o for yo (compro), and -a for él (compra).
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the nosotros form of 'cantar' (to sing) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: For -ar verbs, nosotros ends in -amos: cantar → cantamos. Compare yo canto and tú cantas - only the ending changes.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for the number 'fifty'?
questions.explanation: Cincuenta is 50 - the tens run treinta (30), cuarenta (40), cincuenta (50), sesenta (60). It starts like cinco (5) because 50 is five tens.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Count in Spanish every day.

questions.question: What is the tu form of 'abrir' (to open) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Abrir is an -ir verb: for tú, drop -ir and add -es (abres); yo is abro and él is abre.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the ellos form of 'trabajar' (to work) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Ellos forms of -ar verbs end in -an: trabajar → trabajan, just as hablar → hablan.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the ellos form of 'hablar' (to speak) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: For -ar verbs, ellos ends in -an (hablan) while él ends in -a (habla) - that final -n makes it plural.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the el/ella form of 'mirar' (to watch) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Él/ella forms of -ar verbs end in -a: mirar → mira. Add -n for ellos (miran) and -s for tú (miras).
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the nosotros form of 'leer' (to read) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Leer is an -er verb, and nosotros takes -emos: leemos. The other -er endings are -o, -es, -e, -en.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for winter?
questions.explanation: The four seasons: la primavera (spring), el verano (summer), el otoño (autumn), el invierno (winter) - invierno is the cold, snowy one.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Invierno is winter.

questions.question: What is the yo form of 'vender' (to sell) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: For -er verbs the yo form ends in -o: vender → vendo, comer → como, beber → bebo.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for 'milk'?
questions.explanation: 'La leche' is feminine - nouns ending in -e can be either gender, so learn the article with the word: la leche, la clase, el arte.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Learn words in pairs.

questions.question: What is the nosotros form of 'vivir' (to live) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Vivir is an -ir verb: nosotros ends in -imos (vivimos), while -er verbs use -emos - that vowel is the difference between -er and -ir.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the tu form of 'estar' in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Estar is irregular and its forms carry written accents: estoy, estás, está, estamos, están - tú takes estás.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Irregular verbs need memorizing.

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for 'school'?
questions.explanation: 'La escuela' is feminine: most nouns ending in -a take la. The school building is la escuela; the classes are las clases.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Learn words in pairs.

questions.question: What is the yo form of 'ir' in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Ir is completely irregular - voy, vas, va, vamos, van share no pattern with the infinitive, so memorize the set; '¡Vamos!' also means 'Let's go!'
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Irregular verbs need memorizing.

questions.question: What is the tu form of 'estudiar' (to study) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Estudiar is an -ar verb: tú adds -as (estudias), and the -iar stem keeps its i in every form.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the tu form of 'hablar' (to speak) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Tú forms of -ar verbs end in -as: hablar → hablas, cantar → cantas - the -s ending marks 'you'.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the nosotros form of 'mirar' (to watch) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Nosotros forms of -ar verbs end in -amos (miramos) - for -ar verbs this form looks the same in the past tense, so context tells the time.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What does 'estar' mean in English?
questions.explanation: Estar also means to be, used for location and temporary states.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Estar is for how or where something is.

questions.question: What does 'la mochila' mean in English?
questions.explanation: 'La mochila' (the backpack) is feminine - nouns ending in -a usually take la, and your mochila is what carries your libros to la escuela.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Mochila is the backpack.

questions.question: How do you say 'I am from Arizona' in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Use ser for origin: Soy de Arizona.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Soy is for where you are from.

questions.question: What is the nosotros form of 'recibir' (to receive) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Recibir is an -ir verb, so nosotros ends in -imos: recibimos - compare -er verbs, which use -emos.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the yo form of 'abrir' (to open) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: The yo form of -ir verbs ends in -o: abrir → abro, escribir → escribo, vivir → vivo.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: How do you say 'What is your name?' in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Ask a friend '¿Cómo te llamas?' - literally 'How do you call yourself?' Answer with 'Me llamo...' plus your name.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: ¿Cómo te llamas? asks your name.

questions.question: What is the nosotros form of 'ser' in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Ser is irregular: soy, eres, es, somos, son. Somos is the nosotros form - 'Nosotros somos amigos' means 'We are friends.'
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Irregular verbs need memorizing.

questions.question: What is the yo form of 'trabajar' (to work) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: The yo form of -ar verbs ends in -o: trabajar → trabajo, hablar → hablo, estudiar → estudio.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the el/ella form of 'leer' (to read) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: For -er verbs, él/ella ends in -e: leer → lee, comer → come. Watch the double e in lee - both letters are written.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for 'dog'?
questions.explanation: 'El perro' is masculine (a female dog is la perra). Most nouns ending in -o take el: el perro, el gato, el libro.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Learn words in pairs.

questions.question: How do you make 'mesa' plural in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Most Spanish nouns add -s: mesa becomes mesas.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Add -s for most plurals.

questions.question: What is the nosotros form of 'trabajar' (to work) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Trabajar is an -ar verb: nosotros ends in -amos (trabajamos), the same ending as cantamos and hablamos.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the tu form of 'leer' (to read) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: For -er verbs, tú ends in -es: leer → lees, vender → vendes. Leer keeps both e's: le-es.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the nosotros form of 'hablar' (to speak) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Hablamos is the nosotros form: -ar verbs use -amos for 'we' - 'Hablamos español' means 'We speak Spanish.'
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for the number 'five'?
questions.explanation: The first five: uno, dos, tres, cuatro, cinco. Cinco shares its root with cincuenta (50) and cinco mil (5,000).
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Count in Spanish every day.

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for the number 'seven'?
questions.explanation: Count up: cinco (5), seis (6), siete (7), ocho (8), nueve (9) - siete is the one that sounds closest to English 'seven'.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Count in Spanish every day.

questions.question: How do you make 'libro' plural in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Most Spanish nouns add -s to make the plural: libro becomes libros.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Add -s for most plurals.

questions.question: What is the ellos form of 'recibir' (to receive) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Ellos forms of -ir verbs end in -en: recibir → reciben, vivir → viven, abrir → abren.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: How do you say 'How are you?' in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Ask '¿Cómo estás?' because feelings and health are temporary states, so they use estar. A standard answer: 'Estoy bien, gracias.'
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: ¿Cómo estás? asks how you are.

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for the number 'six'?
questions.explanation: Seis is 6: uno, dos, tres, cuatro, cinco, seis. Sixteen fuses diez + seis into one word: dieciséis (note the accent).
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Count in Spanish every day.

questions.question: What is the ellos form of 'vivir' (to live) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: For -ir verbs, ellos ends in -en: vivir → viven. Only the nosotros form (-imos) separates -ir from -er verbs.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the capital of Spain?
questions.explanation: Madrid is Spain's capital and largest city. Barcelona is famous too, but it is the capital of Catalonia, not of Spain.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Madrid is the capital.

questions.question: Which word is the definite article for feminine plural nouns?
questions.explanation: Las goes with feminine plural nouns, like las casas.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Las is feminine plural.

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for 'friend'?
questions.explanation: 'El amigo' is a male friend; a female friend is la amiga. Nouns ending in -o are usually masculine and take el.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Learn words in pairs.

questions.question: What is the el/ella form of 'escuchar' (to listen) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Él/ella forms of -ar verbs end in -a: escuchar → escucha - 'Ella escucha música' means 'She listens to music.'
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the el/ella form of 'vender' (to sell) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: For -er verbs, él/ella ends in -e: vender → vende, exactly like comer → come and beber → bebe.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the yo form of 'hablar' (to speak) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Every regular yo form ends in -o: hablar → hablo. If a verb form ends in -o, the subject is 'I'.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the el/ella form of 'nadar' (to swim) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Nadar is an -ar verb, so él takes -a: nada. Careful: 'nada' by itself can also mean 'nothing' - context tells which.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the el/ella form of 'comprar' (to buy) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Compra is the él/ella form of comprar (-ar verbs take -a for he/she); the same word, la compra, is also the noun 'shopping/purchase'.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for 'cat'?
questions.explanation: 'El gato' is masculine (female: la gata). Most -o nouns take el - el gato, el perro, el libro.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Learn words in pairs.

questions.question: What is the yo form of 'leer' (to read) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Leo is the yo form of leer: -er and -ir verbs both use -o for yo (leo, como, vivo).
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the yo form of 'ser' in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Ser is irregular from the first form: soy, eres, es, somos, son. Use ser for identity and origin - 'Yo soy estudiante' (I am a student).
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Irregular verbs need memorizing.

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for 'house'?
questions.explanation: 'La casa' is feminine: most nouns ending in -a take la - la casa, la mesa, la puerta.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Learn words in pairs.

questions.question: What is the el/ella form of 'tener' in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Tener is stem-changing (e → ie) in most forms: tengo, tienes, tiene, tenemos, tienen - nosotros keeps the plain e, and yo adds a g (tengo).
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Irregular verbs need memorizing.

questions.question: What is the ellos form of 'correr' (to run) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Ellos forms of -er verbs end in -en: correr → corren, comer → comen, leer → leen.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for the number 'four'?
questions.explanation: Cuatro is 4 - it shares the 'cuatr-' root with cuarenta (40) and cuatrocientos (400).
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Count in Spanish every day.

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for 'sun'?
questions.explanation: 'El sol' is masculine. Sol also appears in English 'solar' - el sol sale en el este (the sun rises in the east).
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Learn words in pairs.

questions.question: What does 'la biblioteca' mean in English?
questions.explanation: 'La biblioteca' is the library building - do not confuse it with the book itself, which is el libro. A biblioteca is full of libros.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Biblioteca is the library.

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for the number 'nine'?
questions.explanation: Nueve is 9, between ocho (8) and diez (10); it shares its root with noventa (90).
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Count in Spanish every day.

questions.question: What is the tu form of 'vivir' (to live) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Tú forms of -ir verbs end in -es: vivir → vives, escribir → escribes - the same ending -er verbs use.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the ellos form of 'leer' (to read) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Leen is the ellos form of leer: -er verbs end in -en for 'they' (leen, comen, corren).
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the ellos form of 'aprender' (to learn) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Aprender is a regular -er verb: ellos ends in -en (aprenden) and yo ends in -o (aprendo).
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the yo form of 'beber' (to drink) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Bebo is the yo form of beber: all regular yo forms end in -o, whatever the verb family.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the yo form of 'correr' (to run) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Correr → corro for yo: drop -er and add -o. The double r stays, so it is pronounced 'KOH-rroh'.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for the number 'eight'?
questions.explanation: Ocho is 8, and 18 fuses diez + ocho into a single word: dieciocho.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Count in Spanish every day.

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for 'I like' when talking about one thing?
questions.explanation: Me gusta is used with one thing: Me gusta el libro.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Me gusta is for one thing.

questions.question: What is the yo form of 'escuchar' (to listen) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Escuchar → escucho: -ar verbs use -o for yo, -as for tú, -a for él - one pattern for every regular -ar verb.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the tu form of 'comer' (to eat) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: For -er verbs, tú ends in -es: comer → comes. All three verb families mark tú with a final -s.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: Which word is the definite article for masculine plural nouns?
questions.explanation: Los goes with masculine plural nouns, like los libros.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Los is masculine plural.

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for the number 'one'?
questions.explanation: Uno is 1 - before a masculine noun it shortens to un (un libro, un perro), and the feminine form is una (una casa).
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Count in Spanish every day.

questions.question: What is the yo form of 'cantar' (to sing) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Cantar → canto: the yo form of every regular verb ends in -o - canto, bailo, estudio.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the el/ella form of 'correr' (to run) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Corre is the él form of correr (-er verbs take -e for he/she); '¡Corre!' is also how you shout 'Run!'
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the yo form of 'tener' in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Tengo is irregular - most yo forms just end in -o, but tener adds a g: tengo, like salgo (salir) and vengo (venir).
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Irregular verbs need memorizing.

questions.question: What is the yo form of 'comer' (to eat) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Como is the yo form of comer. Careful: 'como' with no accent also means 'like/as', while '¿cómo?' with an accent means 'how?'.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What does 'Tengo trece años' mean in English?
questions.explanation: Spanish uses tener for age, not ser: 'Tengo trece años' is literally 'I have thirteen years.' And the ñ is essential - años means years.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Tengo años tells your age.

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for the number 'two'?
questions.explanation: Dos is 2: uno, dos, tres. The dos root also builds doce (12), veinte (20), and doscientos (200).
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Count in Spanish every day.

questions.question: What is the tu form of 'escribir' (to write) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Escribir is an -ir verb: tú ends in -es (escribes); only nosotros (-imos, escribimos) shows it is -ir and not -er.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the el/ella form of 'trabajar' (to work) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Trabaja is the él/ella form of trabajar: -ar verbs take -a for he/she, as in 'Ella trabaja hoy' (She works today).
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the ellos form of 'abrir' (to open) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Abren is the ellos form of abrir: -ir verbs end in -en for 'they' - abren, escriben, viven.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the yo form of 'estar' in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Estoy is the yo form of irregular estar: estoy, estás, está, estamos, están - note the written accents on estás, está and están.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Irregular verbs need memorizing.

questions.question: What is the capital of Mexico?
questions.explanation: Mexico City (Ciudad de México) is the capital and largest city of Mexico; Guadalajara and Monterrey are major cities, but neither is the capital.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Mexico City is the capital.

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for Sunday?
questions.explanation: Days of the week are not capitalized in Spanish: lunes, martes, miércoles, jueves, viernes, sábado, domingo - miércoles and sábado carry written accents.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Domingo is Sunday.

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for 'black'?
questions.explanation: 'Negro' agrees with its noun: el perro negro, but la casa negra - colors ending in -o change for gender and number (negros, negras).
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Learn words in pairs.

questions.question: What is the yo form of 'nadar' (to swim) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Nado is the yo form of nadar: drop -ar, add -o. 'Yo nado' means 'I swim'; the sport itself is la natación.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the ellos form of 'beber' (to drink) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Beben is the ellos form of beber: -er verbs take -en for 'they' (beben, comen, leen).
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the el/ella form of 'hablar' (to speak) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Habla is the él/ella form of hablar: 'Él habla español' (He speaks Spanish) - and '¡Habla!' is the command 'Speak!'
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: Which verb do you use to say where something is located?
questions.explanation: Use estar for location: La escuela está aquí.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Estar is for location.

questions.question: What is the ellos form of 'nadar' (to swim) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Nadan is the ellos form of nadar: -ar verbs take -an for 'they' - nadan, cantan, bailan.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for the number 'one hundred'?
questions.explanation: Cien is exactly 100; add anything more and it becomes ciento: ciento uno (101), ciento veinte (120). Mil is 1,000.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Count in Spanish every day.

questions.question: What does 'Me llamo Ana' mean in English?
questions.explanation: Llamarse is reflexive: 'Me llamo Ana' literally says 'I call myself Ana.' For someone else: 'Se llama...' (His/Her name is...).
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Me llamo introduces yourself.

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for 'green'?
questions.explanation: 'Verde' works for both genders because it ends in -e: el libro verde, la casa verde; only the plural changes (verdes).
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Learn words in pairs.

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for 'blue'?
questions.explanation: 'Azul' is blue for both genders (el cielo azul, la casa azul); its plural adds -es: azules.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Learn words in pairs.

questions.question: What is the Spanish word for summer?
questions.explanation: The seasons in order: la primavera (spring), el verano (summer - the hot beach season), el otoño (autumn), el invierno (winter).
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Verano is summer.

questions.question: What is the ellos form of 'escuchar' (to listen) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Escuchan is the ellos form of escuchar: -ar verbs end in -an for 'they' (escuchan, miran, nadan).
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: How do you say 'Please' in Spanish?
questions.explanation: 'Por favor' is literally 'as a favor' - attach it to any request: 'La cuenta, por favor' (The check, please).
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Por favor means please.

questions.question: What does 'por favor' mean in English?
questions.explanation: Keep the polite trio straight: por favor = please (when asking), gracias = thank you, and de nada = you're welcome (when answering).
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Por favor means please.

questions.question: What is the el/ella form of 'estudiar' (to study) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Estudia is the él/ella form of estudiar (-ar verbs take -a): 'Ella estudia mucho' means 'She studies a lot.'
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the nosotros form of 'ir' in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Vamos is the nosotros form of ir - and by itself, '¡Vamos!' is the everyday command 'Let's go!'
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Irregular verbs need memorizing.

questions.question: What is the nosotros form of 'tener' in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Tenemos is the one calm form of tener: the e → ie stem change skips nosotros - tenemos, never 'tienemos'.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Irregular verbs need memorizing.

questions.question: What is the ellos form of 'escribir' (to write) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Escriben is the ellos form of escribir: -ir verbs end in -en for 'they' - escriben, abren, viven.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: What is the yo form of 'aprender' (to learn) in the present tense?
questions.explanation: Aprendo is the yo form of aprender, a regular -er verb: -o for yo, -es for tú, -e for él, -emos for nosotros, -en for ellos.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Conjugate by dropping the ending and adding the right one.

questions.question: How do you say 'Goodbye' in Spanish?
questions.explanation: 'Adiós' (with the accent on the ó) is goodbye; 'hola' is hello, and 'hasta luego' means 'see you later'.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Adiós means goodbye.
